articles.title: Your Laugh Is a 15-Million-Year-Old Echo!
articles.summary: Did you know your giggle is ancient? Scientists found that humans and great apes share the same laugh rhythm. It’s a 15-million-year-old clue to how speech began.

articles.title: Hawaii Is Paving Roads with Old Fishing Nets!
articles.summary: What if trash could become a road? Hawaii is testing asphalt made from recycled fishing nets and plastic bottles. Early tests show it works and doesn’t shed extra microplastics.

articles.title: Hubble’s 13-Billion-Year-Old Firework Show!
articles.summary: NASA’s Hubble telescope snapped a glittering star cluster that’s almost as old as the universe. NGC 6426 is 13 billion years old and looks like a cosmic sparkler.
